values.meaning: Increased Base Health (percent of missing health)

values.binNote: Per-tick value is derived from the total regen (MaxHealthHoT: 0.2/0.4/0.6) divided by 20 ticks over the 10s duration (0.5s tick interval); the bin has no separate per-tick data value.

values.meaning: Rank 3 bonus per nearby enemy champion at cast, to increased base health and health regeneration
values.quote: increased by 5% for each enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1200 units at the time of cast

mechanics.claim: The health regeneration from Maximum Dosage scales dynamically with Dr. Mundo's current maximum health, not a snapshot taken at cast.
mechanics.quote: The health regeneration granted by ''Maximum Dosage'' adjusts dynamically to '''Dr. Mundo's''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: Maximum Dosage's effects end early if Dr. Mundo dies and enters resurrection during its duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Maximum Dosage'' will end prematurely upon entering {{tip|resurrection}}.

mechanics.claim: At rank 3, the increased base health and bonus health regeneration are each increased 5% per enemy champion within 1200 units at the moment of cast (e.g. 85% max health regen and 50% missing bonus health against 5 champions).
mechanics.quote: Against 5 champions, Rank 3 ''Maximum Dosage'' will heal {{as|85% '''Maximum''' health regeneration}} & {{as|50% '''Missing''' Bonus health}}
